score: Count one point for each passed item; minimum 0, maximum 10. Every check reads only the unified diff.

items.mechanical_check: The diff adds at least one non-comment, non-blank implementation line outside test files.
The diff adds or modifies at least one mechanically recognizable test file or inline test module.
Added test code contains an assertion or an explicit expected-result comparison.
Added test code mechanically names or asserts both a success/accept path and a failure/reject path.
An added test name or test line names empty, null, none, missing, zero, min, max, boundary, absent, invalid, or malformed input.
Added implementation code contains an explicit empty/null/none/absent check rather than relying only on the happy path.
Added implementation code uses a typed error/result/status construct (for example Result, Option, an error type, or a named exit/status code).
No added implementation line introduces panic, unimplemented, todo, bare throw, or forced unwrap/expect shortcuts.
No added line contains TODO, FIXME, XXX, HACK, placeholder, or not implemented.
The diff changes at most four files and does not touch contracts, vendored/generated dependencies, lockfiles, CI configuration, or acceptance tests.
